title: Hallelujah | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Elevator And Community Pool- Hallelujah By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Hallelujah by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 18 Garfield Street Details: Hallelujah is a stunning home located on Western Lake in the exclusive Grayton Landing development. A short walk to the beach and footsteps away from the lake, this home has everything to offer! Take a dip in the community pool only accessible to the 6 homes inside the gated community. The pool has a bathhouse for changing, outdoor kitchen with a large grill, lounge chairs, bar and dining tables, umbrellas, and hammocks. Each floor of the house has a furnished porch to view the beautiful natural surroundings of this lakeside property. Take a walk straight down Garfield Street just 550 yards to the beach. Be sure to stop at Chiringo’s, the open- air beach bar, for their signature drink the Billy Ocean and some nachos or the famous Red Bar. Or enjoy shopping at the Zoo Gallery, Grayt Tshirt Shop, or Florida Georgia Line’s Tribe Kelley Surf Post with their personally designed clothing, jewelry, and bath line. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -New Construction -Distance to Beach 550 yards -Parking spaces: 6 in driveway -Gourmet Kitchen with Wolf and Sub-Zero Appliances -Coffee Maker Available -Propane Grill (at house and at pool) -Community Pool for 6 houses -Lake Views -Elevator Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 beds/5.5 Baths First Floor: -Entry and access to Elevator -Half Bath -Screened in Porch with Gathering area Second Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Large Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Kitchen/Dining Area/Living Room (Table for 8, Bar Seating for 4, 2 Large Sofas, and 2 Swivel Rockers -Deck with Dining Table for 8, Sofa, Table, and 2 Chairs Third Floor: -Bedroom 2: (Master) Queen Bed with Large Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: (2) Twin Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub combo) -Laundry Area -Deck with Porch Swing and Chairs Fourth Floor: -Bedroom 5: (2) Twin/Twin Bunk Bed Sets (4) with Large Shared Bath (shower) -Entertainment Room/TV and Wet Bar with Mini Refrigerator -Sun Deck overlooking the Lake and Pool Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
